proposals.evidence: CDIAL 11302 vayam explicitly gives Maiya bē, Chiliss/Gowro be and Palula be/beh we. These survey be/beh forms select that pronoun family; the exact source number is retained. Exact survey form be is preserved; intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.
